## Summary
- Adds `bin/merge-line-select`: pure decision function over one GraphQL snapshot. Flags: `--live --repo`, `--list`, `--pr N`, `--dry-run`, `--summary`. Outputs `action`, `head`, `head_state`, `skipped`, `clear`, `queue_len`, `dry_run`.
- Adds `bin/test-merge-line-select`; wired into the `bin/test-*` step in `tests.yml`.
- Adds fixtures captured 2026-09-29: `live-snapshot.json`, `live-snapshot.expected`, `live-dry-run.txt` (queue 3, head PR gets `update`).
- `update-behind-prs.yml`: rewired to select only the head of the merge line — the oldest armed PR that is not conflicted and not red on a required check. An UNKNOWN head holds the line; the pass never skips past it to a later PR.
- Splits the run step into checkout → coalesce → select → update → notify.
- Adds `workflow_dispatch` inputs `pr` (update one named PR) and `dry_run` (report only, no writes). Dry-run and named-PR dispatches get their own concurrency-group suffixes (`-dryrun`, `-pr`), so neither cancels a live push pass.
- `pr-canary.yml`: enumerate step now calls `bin/merge-line-select --live --repo "$REPO" --list` instead of `gh pr list`; adds the required permissions block (`contents:read`, `pull-requests:read`, `checks:read`, `statuses:read`).
- Removed: all-open-PR freshness sweep (unarmed PRs are no longer kept current by this workflow), daily `30 11 * * *` cron, 60-min master-quiet debounce on the schedule path, event-based `SCOPE_FILTER` branching.
- Armed PRs skipped for red checks or a merge conflict receive a `<!-- merge-line-skip -->` sticky comment posted via `GITHUB_TOKEN`; cleared automatically on the first pass where they rejoin the line.

## Summary

- Fixes two independent false-positive paths in the fidelity harness that caused `MISSING-METHOD:` errors for methods that were present (a-jay85/IBL5-backlog#1133).

**`conformance.py` — bash guard declarations missed**

The diff-body check only recognised `function name` / `def name` style declarations. Shell guards written as `name() {` at the start of a line (e.g. `g_no_merge() {` in #2441, #2432) were never matched, so they were always reported missing.

Fix: the regex now has a second branch that matches a bare `name()` at the start of a diff line (after an optional `+` prefix and indentation). Call-sites like `$this->name()` are not affected because the branch anchors to start-of-line with `re.MULTILINE`.

**`planfile.py` — `parse_required_test_methods` over-captured**

Two classes of bullets were incorrectly extracted as method names:

1. Path bullets — `` - `ibl5/tests/SearchViewTest.php` `` yielded `ibl5`; `` - `bin/test-harness` `` yielded `bin`. The old regex stopped at the first non-identifier character, so any identifier before a `/` or `::` was captured.
2. Label phrases — `- Static guards in ...` yielded `Static`; `- Ported from ...` yielded `Ported`. Any bullet was accepted regardless of what followed the first identifier.

Fix: the parse loop now runs two passes. Pass 1 handles backtick-wrapped tokens: it greedily matches the longest identifier, then checks the very next character — if it is `/`, `:`, or a space, the bullet is discarded.
